title: BLESSINGS AND SAFETY for “ASSALAMU ALAIKUM”
body:
Audhu bi-llahi mina Shaitan rajim, Bismillair Rahmanir Rahim, la haula wa la quwatta
illa bi-llahi-l ‘Aliyu-l ‘Adhim.
Assalamu Alaikum. It is a very holy sign of Islam to say Assalamu Alaikum. As much
as you say Assalamu Alaikum, tanzilu-l Rahma, blessings come on people. Therefore
always do it. Assalamu Alaikum. The Lord of heavens is answering and saying, “I am
As-Salam”. If I am sending my salaam and you are asking salaams for each other I am
sending mercy and blessings on you. No other word or expression can have the
same blessings as that of Salaams. For example, a person may say “Good Morning,
“Bon Jour, Bon Bonido, Guten Morgen or Guten Tag,” but non of these expressions
can be as the greeting of Assalam. People are forgetting this and are using the
expressions and greetings used by the non Muslims. But it is not the same as saying
“Assalamu Alaikum”. When you say “Assalamu Alaikum”, Allah Almighty gives to your
physical being refreshment and it also feeds your souls and your spirituality. This
comes from hearts to hearts through those holy words “Assalamu Alaikum” and as I
said it will give to you refreashment, pleasure and also safety.
“Assalamu Alaikum,” also protects you from every bad thing which might reach you. It
will be a shelter for yourself both here and in the hereafter. But sad to say people
have lost it now. Therefore instead of blessings, cursings are coming on to people
now. This is why Shaitan is urging people to refuse these holy words. Yes, and Holy
Words are words that have come from the Heavens. They have a power and
refreshment and they are and they have life, but Shaitan is asking mankind not to be
in refreshment and in pleasure. Pleasure comes from heavens and not from earth.

Pleasure that’s comes from the earth are like that of the animals who take from the
earth for eating and drinking and other material reasons. These never give you
pleasure as pleasure comes from the Heavens. People have lost this now. The
people of today are asking for pleasure which is earthly. From east to west, Shaitan is
busy making these pleasure centers which enables people to take pleasure from
eating, drinking and from sex. But this is not real pleasure because these pleasures
are in limits. You can only taste this for a short period of time. Then this is cut off from you.
For example if I give you honey in the quantity of one spoonful, you will say, “it is ok,
thank you sir, danke.” Then I will say, “please take one more spoon.” You may take
that also and then I will go on to say, “please take one more spoon for your pleasure,
and if you say, “this spoon is too small, I shall bring a soup spoon for you”. And you
will say, “that soup spoon is too much for me”. But I will say, “no, no, no. Very good.
This is sweet honey, so sweet, it is not even artificial honey, it is natural, therefore you
must eat”. Then you scream at me, “enough! but I can’t.” But I’ll say, “you must be
drunk because you liked this so much before, yes you liked it too much, therefore I am
trying to make you happy and for you to be in pleasure by giving you more.” But he
says to me, “enough, I cannot take any more.” This is like the method of Shaitan.
Shaitan is creating so many types of dirty centers for people to take pleasure in and
to enjoy and to be pleased. But like I said before the first night is okay. Then the
second night it becomes less of a pleasure and then on the third night it becomes
even less than the second night and so on and so forth until finally they are saying,
“we are fed up with this place, therefore we must look whether there is another center,
yes we must change our atmosphere.”
In this manner they are going from one place to another until they begin to say, “we
want to now go to other countries where it might be much more pleasurable for us.”
These pleasures belong to our physical beings and finally at the end it is going to
finish. But real pleasures come from the Heavens. Do you think that a person can be
fed up of praying. No. This cannot be. A person may pray five times a day and still

he will find pleasure going through his soul. It is real pleasure coming from the
heavens. But still people are behaving like animals and they do not taste anything
except barley and green grass. They do not ask for the soul’s pleasure. They run
only after physical pleasure, and this gets lesser day by day and finally comes to a
point that no pleasure is given to the body at all because the body has stopped
responding and answering anymore. It is like the doctors saying, “we will give you
medicine, please take it, and if it doesn’t answer we will change it for you.” In this
manner everything that they are advertising today for your physical pleasure is
making people think that they bring another new type of physical enjoyment. But this
is not real pleasure as these things belong to our physical beings and the physical
bodies are within limits and if you give it more of this material enjoyment it is going to
become restless and unrest becomes their portion. They then say, “enough, enough I
cannot take much more of this.”
On the other hand the one who is asking for heavenly pleasures and who has tasted it
is never going to say that he is fed up. No. A person may pray five times a day but
you will never hear him say that he is fed up. The more the person prays the more is
the confidence, refreshment and pleasure that he get through his soul. He will never
say, “I am fed up with praying. No.” A person may get up for praying during the night
time when others are busy sleeping. He makes ablution and comes to pray but you will
never hear this person saying, “I am fed up tonight and therefore I am not going
to wake up to pray.” Even if he intends to do this when the time for the night prayer is
approaching- Subhanallah, it becomes impossible for that person to sleep and he
says, “I must get up.”
But the people of today are following satanic teachings and these teachings finally
take them to drugs and other poisons because when the material and physical being
comes to the point of zero it gives no more tasting for eating for drinking and for sex.
When this happens Shaitan says, “now we must take you into another atmosphere
that you will be happy in. You should be very happy in this new place. In this place

you will find never ending pleasure.” When Shaitan has finished with his games that
person also finishes physically and also spiritually he becomes empty. In this way the
people of the present time are being constantly cheated by Shaitan. They are
cheated by these teachings but still insist on following these satanic ways. They do
not take the time to look at the direction of their souls. They say, “no, we are very
happy with our material being and material enjoyment is enough for us.” They begin
to prepare for this during their youth and they run on it up to the end.
All the troubles that the world faces today is because of the satanic teachings that
they follow asking for their enjoyment. They think that they have been only created to
enjoy themselves, to play and to run after the physical and material aspects and in
this way they enter into the wrong way. If they do not stop this, they will fall down.
People are so foolish now.
Today people are so afraid of bird flu. They say, “that virus is terrible.” They are only
concentrating on this bird flu and millions of youngsters today are falling into
dangerous situations. They are not being advised on this. People never seem to
care about this and they are now opening even more pleasure centers and inviting
the youngsters to come there. These youngsters are the customers of these
pleasure centers and they are being milked like cows and the owners of these places
are the ones milking them. They do not think of the future of these youngsters. Even
the governments are not taking any care to prevent these youngsters from destroying
themselves as the leaders in government are the representatives of Shaitan and are
working for him. They give freedom to youngsters to do as they like. This is a very
wrong thing to do, but still they are doing this and they tell their youngsters, “you are
free and you may do anything.” They are also saying to them, “you must not take
care of heavenly orders or commands, instead just run after your egos and your
egoistic pleasures.” Nothing else. They never take care of their youngsters.
It is a sign of the Last Days that they are making people not to believe in Heavenly
Ways. They don’t want to hear anything from Holy Books. However there are

countless TV centers and internet centers but no one is approaching the most
important aspect in life. This is like a roundabout going around and around. If
mankind do not use their minds to ask for blessings from their Lord by saying
“Assalamu Alaikum”, then instead of blessings cursing shall come. The world is today
under heavenly cursing. Even the ants are cursing mankind because a fire might
even come on them because of mankind and burn them. They are also cursing those
people who are following Shaitan and not saying, “Assalamu Alaikum.”
Oh people, use our minds to understand and don’t be always drunk. Leave the drinks
that make you drunk and use heavenly advices and follow the ways of the Prophets,
particularly the last Prophet Seyyadina Muhammed (sal) so that it will be able to carry
people and lead them on to paradise. Keep His commands and keep His advice if you
like to live with honour both here and in the hereafter. If not, even if you were to
repent in your last moments it may not give any benefit to you. May Allah forgive us.
Assalamu Alaikum, Assalamu Alaikum, Assalamu Alaikum, ya ‘ibadullahi salihin!
When a peoples intentions are good, blessings come on them. But if they change
their intentions to badness then cursings shall reached to them. May Allah forgive
you and bless you for the honour of the most honoured one in His Divine Presence,
Seyyadina Muhammed (sal). Fathiha.
Lefke, 19.3.2006 Transcribed by Khairiyah Siegel
